description: Transition plugin hooks — automatic session-transition capture for any project that enables transition@local. PreCompact injects custom compaction instructions (and a stale-/memory-gc nudge); PostCompact writes the compact summary to .workspace/transitions/YYYY-MM-DD/HH.md; SessionEnd appends an exit marker to the same file. All three resolve their target from $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (the top-level project dir Claude Code always sets for hooks), so they are safe at the plugin level and do NOT reintroduce the shell-cwd bug that got the old UserPromptSubmit hourly-stub hook removed on 2026-08-05. init-transition.sh is kept but unregistered. Manual handoffs use the workflow plugin's /handoff and /continue skills.
